title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Pleno - Back-end (.NET)
description:
Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Engenheira de Software Pleno com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento backend utilizando .NET, com foco em arquitetura escalável, qualidade técnica e integração com serviços em nuvem. Este profissional será responsável por apoiar decisões técnicas, evolução de sistemas e boas práticas de engenharia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter APIs RESTful escaláveis e seguras;
  • Participar da definição e evolução da arquitetura de software;
  • Garantir qualidade técnica por meio de testes automatizados e revisão de código;
  • Consultas SQL e manipulação de dados complexos em bancos relacionados;
  • Integrar serviços de mensagem e cache para sistemas distribuídos;
  • Colaborar em processos de CI/CD e práticas DevOps;
  • Monitorar e observar sistemas com ferramentas especializadas;
  • Aplicar ferramentas de IA para apoio ao desenvolvimento de software;
  • Atuar em tempos ágeis, contribuindo com melhorias contínuas e entregas iterativas;
  • Participar de decisões técnicas e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • .NET Core / C# : domínio da linguagem, async/await, lambda, using, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core;
  • Orientação a objetos : encapsulamento, herança, polimorfismo, abstrações, interfaces, agregação e composição;
  • Arquitetura de software : REST, arquitetura orientada a eventos;
  • Boas práticas de Engenharia de Software: SOLID, código limpo, DRY, YAGNI, KISS;
  • Testes : unitários, integração, mocks e stubs;
  • Banco de dados : MySQL e Oracle, SQL avançado (joins, subconsultas, agregações), procedimentos armazenados, triggers, transações e isolamento;
  • Cache : Redis / Elasticache;
  • Controle de versão : Git, resolução de conflitos, pull requests;
  • Contêineres e DevOps : Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, pipelines CI/CD;
  • Monitoramento : Prometheus, Grafana, DataDog;
  • Mensageria : RabbitMQ;
  • Ferramentas de IA : conhecimento na utilização de IA para apoio ao desenvolvimento de software;
  • Metodologias ágeis : experiência com Scrum, Kanban ou similares.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência com migração de sistemas e modernização de legados;
  • Vivência prévia com produtos financeiros, especialmente crédito.

title: Sales Operations & Data Analyst
description:
Nossa organização de Operações de Vendas é responsável por construir a melhor estratégia de entrada no mercado para conectar nossas soluções às necessidades dos clientes em escala. Como Analista de Estratégia e Operações de Vendas, você trabalhará em parceria com seus colegas para resolver os tópicos estratégicos mais importantes da organização de vendas, impulsionando o crescimento da receita, melhorando a produtividade das vendas e agregando valor aos clientes.

O analista deve ser altamente adaptável, possuir fortes habilidades de comunicação e ter um histórico comprovado de entrega de análises sem erros em cargos anteriores. O candidato também deve ser capaz de lidar com informações sensíveis, confidenciais e não rotineiras, estar aberto a questionar o status quo e trabalhar em uma organização em rápida transformação, ao mesmo tempo em que inspira excelência em si mesmo(a) e nos parceiros de negócios.

Responsabilidades

• Participar de um programa global de transformação de operações

• Contribuir para e comunicar os processos de negócios atuais e futuros, fluxos de dados e diagramas de processos, jornadas dos usuários e fluxos de trabalho

• Criar e manter acompanhamentos de projetos (trackers), bem como canais de comunicação para gerenciar ações de forma eficaz, cumprindo prazos enquanto trabalha em ritmo acelerado

• Avaliar e comunicar regularmente restrições e riscos dos projetos em nível global; identificar dependências, decisões estratégicas, planos de mitigação

• Recomendar soluções para melhorar a produtividade, reduzir a complexidade geral, minimizar dívidas técnicas e possibilitar uma melhor integridade de dados, apoiando pesquisas com usuários (User Research) para aprimorar a experiência do usuário (UX) do produto, atuando como defensor(a) do usuário para as equipes de Operações de Vendas / Vendas

• Estabelecer relacionamentos sólidos de trabalho com colegas de outras equipes de Operações de Vendas e parceiros multifuncionais para alcançar os objetivos

Qualificações Básicas

• Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência em consultoria de gestão, finanças, operações de vendas, operações de negócios ou em funções analíticas/operacionais

• Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência com SFDC (Salesforce) e D365 (Dynamics 365), fluência em SQL, Power BI/Tableau e Excel

Qualificações Desejáveis

• Atenção excepcional aos detalhes: aprendizado ágil com atenção meticulosa aos detalhes e experiência comprovada em identificar pontos de falha em processos

• Experiência com escalabilidade: confortável com dados e incertezas; consegue rapidamente fazer conexões e identificar causas raiz; mergulha nos detalhes e táticas operacionais, ao mesmo tempo em que contribui com a visão estratégica e resolve problemas operacionais

• Experiência com processos e ferramentas de vendas: especialista em fluxos e processos de vendas (ex.: planejamento de headcount, construção de territórios, definição de metas, previsões), operações e ferramentas (ex.: Salesforce, Dynamics 365); experiência na implementação de sistemas de terceiros e uso de metodologias ágeis

• Comunicação clara e eficaz: traduz pensamentos e estratégias complexas em recomendações simples e acionáveis, tanto por escrito quanto verbalmente, em um ambiente dinâmico e orientado por dados — inclusive com apresentações para públicos diversos

• Responsabilidade e priorização: experiência atuando com supervisão limitada no dia a dia, gerenciando múltiplas prioridades e cumprindo prazos

• Proatividade e atitude positiva: busca informações de forma independente, resolve problemas conceituais, mobiliza recursos e entrega resultados em situações desafiadoras e multifacetadas; motivado(a) e engajado(a) para colaborar em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante mudança

Habilidades Sugeridas:

• Proficiência técnica em SFDC, D365, SQL, Power BI/Tableau e Excel

• Otimização de processos e resolução de problemas operacionais

• Especialização em operações e fluxos de trabalho de vendas

• Comunicação clara e eficaz

• Adaptabilidade e iniciativa proativa

title: Volunteer Doctor, South Africa
description:
Are you passionate about using your knowledge and skills to help others? Answer your calling, and take your leave of purpose.

The Tshemba Foundation is appealing to international doctors to address a critical health care gap in rural South Africa’s north eastern provinces where doctor shortages are posing substantial challenges to adequate health care.

You will experience and learn from a stimulating and challenging working environment, treat conditions and cases not usually seen in urban areas and help leave a legacy of improved quality of care by sharing knowledge and skills with local staff who are eager for support.

Tshemba offers its volunteers free, safe and secure accommodation at its Volunteer Lodge, situated in Moditlo Private Game Reserve. The Lodge serves as a welcome off-duty refuge where like-minded healthcare providers relax after an intense day of work. Here they exchange ideas, create healthcare solutions for daily challenges faced and connect with peers from all over the world, all the while taking in the magnificent natural surroundings.

In your role as a volunteer doctor you can offer:

  • direct or indirect patient care in various departments of a public hospital and/or surrounding clinics
  • postgraduate support to medical staff in training
  • skills development and/or formal teaching for local staff
  • administrative or management support, including clinical and quality improvement projects
  • develop health interventions and protocols alongside local staff

Our clinical team will work with you to develop a personalized volunteer schedule that combines your skills and experience with the needs of various hospital departments and clinics in the area.

Length of placement:

  • Currently, volunteer placement lengths are flexible based on your area of expertise. We recommend a minimum of 8 weeks for generalist international volunteers and can negotiate shorter stays for specialists. We will work with you to determine where you will be placed and how long your stay will be to have maximum impact.

Requirements:

  • A current license in good standing from your medical regulatory body
  • Registration with ECFMG and the Health Professionals Council of South Africa (HPCSA) which our team will assist you to apply for. Current ECFMG certification will expedite the process.
  • We welcome interest from ALL REGISTERED PHYSICIANS however, the greatest current need are for Radiologists, Family physicians, Geriatricians, Neurologists, Dermatologists, Internists, Psychiatrists, Paediatricians, Gastroenterologists, Ophthalmologists and General Surgeons.

Physicians who have volunteered with Tshemba tell us that they have been re-energized and transformed by the experience, and their passion for medicine reignited.

Please reach out if you have any questions and to discuss volunteering your time.

title: JAMS Automation Engineer
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.

We are looking for a highly talented and self-motivated to join us on our journey to advance the world of technology through innovation and creativity.

This role will be responsible for automating repeatable processes in Sompo’s public cloud and on-premise datacenter environments to improve process efficiencies. This role will be responsible for developing, documenting, maintaining, supporting, and optimizing automation workflows. Subject matter expertise is required in Microsoft PowerShell scripting.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop, test and validate PowerShell scripts as part of automation workflows and maintain in source control for change management.

• Create and Maintain a Dynamic Inventory of all JAMS Scheduler Jobs.

• Create and maintain a JAMS incident tracker for logging dates and times of all warnings and errors from JAMS Scheduler Jobs as well as escalation and fix details.

• Update Job properties (Schedules, Source Code etc.) as directed by Job owners.

• Proactively review and monitor the health of all JAMS Jobs i.e. daily reviewing output of all jobs.

• Review job failures and take corrective action where possible or escalate to Job owner as necessary.

• Log Service Desk ticket (incident) for all JAMS Scheduler Job failures, provide resolution in collaboration with job owner and maintain incident resolution log\ knowledge base.

• Installation of JAMS Client tools, JAMS software updates and\or reporting tools.

• Liaise with JAMS account representative and Sompo procurement in relation to JAMS Scheduler annual support License renewals.

• Participate in IT projects, responsible for development of automation workflows outlined in the Project Plan and directed by the Project Manager, at whatever level of effort or participation has been defined for them.

• Build, administer, monitor and maintain JAMS Enterprise Scheduler and System Center Orchestrator environments.

• Work with Application team members to evaluate automation workflow needs and requirements.

• Develop integrations between infrastructure systems for data analysis and reporting through REST API calls.

• Maintain JAMS platform, standard operating procedures, perform changes, apply patches, and updates as required.

• Prevent, diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve automation runbook errors.

• Maintain strict change control of the automation infrastructure.

• Continuously identify and report areas of improvement in the automation arena and implement improvements when approved.

• Contribute to on-going research and evaluation of new technologies.

• Responsible for completing other work requirements or tasks that are requested by IT management when necessary to meet the goals and objectives of the department or company.

• Working continuously on a task until completion to ensure business automation workflows remain available 24/7.

• The ability to multitask while ensuring the highest quality of work is maintained.

• Establishing a good working relationship with customers and other IT groups.

• Be able to work independently within established policies and procedures.

• Perform routine tasks unsupervised.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS

• Excellent technical skills including however not limited to Microsoft Operating systems server including PowerShell scripting, Microsoft SQL Server , Microsoft Azure including Logic Apps, JSON Scripting, REST API.

• Azure or AWS Certification is desirable.

• Experience with System Center Orchestrator 2012 or later preferred.

• Experience with JAMS Enterprise Manager is highly desirable and preferred.

GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong background in an Infrastructure environment with a minimum of 5 years’ experience.

• Team orientated with the ability to multitask and prioritize workloads.

• Very strong problem solving and analytical skills and is a systemic thinker with an attention to detail.

• Seeks to expand knowledge and experience and is committed to continuous learning.

Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. We offer comprehensive benefits to all employees

We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" and "Top Employer" in 17 countries, and recognized as a “Top Employer” in Brazil specifically, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect

Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Desenvolvedor FICO
description:
Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir motores de decisão utilizando FICO DM, DMPS e RMA.
  • Definir, implementar e validar regras de negócio em plataformas de decisão, garantindo alta performance, acurácia e governança.
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em estratégias e políticas automatizadas.
  • Garantir qualidade, documentação e rastreabilidade das implementações.
  • Apoiar na definição de padrões e melhores práticas no uso de motores de decisão.

Requisitos Técnicos

Imprescindíveis

  • Experiência sólida em FICO Decision Management (DM, DMPS, RMA).
  • Desenvolvimento, configuração e manutenção de motores de decisão.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados, modelagem de regras e parametrização de políticas.
  • Experiência em integração de motores de decisão com sistemas corporativos (APIs, batch, mensageria).
  • Conhecimento em testes e validação de regras para garantir consistência e qualidade.

Desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em SAS Vaya e demais suítes de decisão da SAS.
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a serviços e eventos (APIs, Kafka, etc.).
  • Familiaridade com Cloud Computing (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Vivência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL.
  • Atuação em ambientes de alta criticidade e missão crítica (risco de crédito, prevenção à fraude).
  • Inglês para leitura, escrita e comunicação em projetos globais.

Habilidades Comportamentais

  • Capacidade de analisar problemas complexos e propor soluções práticas.
  • Boa comunicação para interagir com áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Proatividade para sugerir melhorias em processos e estratégias de decisão.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes na documentação e versionamento de regras.
  • Colaboração em times multidisciplinares, com postura consultiva.
  • Adaptabilidade para lidar com mudanças rápidas em regras de negócio.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em SAS Vaya e outras suítes de decisão SAS.
  • Experiência em projetos de crédito, cobrança, prevenção a fraude e risco.
  • Certificações em FICO ou SAS.
  • Experiência em cloud native decisioning (integração com serviços em nuvem).
  • Inglês avançado para projetos internacionais.

title: Mobility Operations Specialist - Relocation
description:
Responsible for the full-process relocation management of expatriate employees upon arrival in the host country, including but not limited to:

1. Coordinating and arranging temporary accommodation and subsequent transitions

2. Providing guidance and assistance for opening local bank accounts

3. Advising on the registration procedures for various permits required in the host country

4. Supporting housing rental matters, including property selection and contract negotiation

5. Managing company apartment resources, including lease agreement signing and daily maintenance

Establishing and maintaining regular communication mechanisms with expatriate employees:

1. Managing expectations before onboarding and clearly communicating relevant policies and important notes of the host country

2. Regularly following up on employees’ adaptation and promptly resolving issues during the relocation process

3. Collecting employee feedback to continuously optimize relocation procedures and service quality

Formulating and improving company expatriate management rules and procedures:

1. Developing standardized global expatriate relocation operation manuals

2. Ensuring procedures comply with local laws, regulations, and internal company policies

3. Collaborating across departments to optimize the expatriate support system

4. Managing suppliers and collaborating to enhance the relocation service experience

Providing comprehensive employee care services:

1. Organizing cultural adaptation training and sharing local life guides

2. Assisting employees and their families in solving daily life challenges in the host country

3. Establishing emergency response mechanisms to safeguard employee safety and rights

Job Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree or above; majors in Human Resource Management, International Business, Cross-cultural Management, or related fields are preferred

- 3–5 years of work experience, with previous management of international assignment projects involving over 100 employees

- Experience in cross-cultural communication or international expatriate relocation managemen

title: Agente de Negócios - Representante Comercial PJ | Açu - RN
description:
Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time

Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia, referência na América Latina. Com soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente, com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Contamos com o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios e o iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre na vanguarda, com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário

Nesta posição, você será o ponto de conexão entre o iFood e novos parceiros de negócios. Seu dia a dia será guiado por estratégias de expansão, conquistando novos clientes em áreas com grande potencial de crescimento.

Entre as principais responsabilidades, você irá:

  • Prospecção de novos parceiros: Identificar oportunidades de mercado e atrair restaurantes e estabelecimentos para o ecossistema iFood.
  • Gestão de funil de vendas: Realizar acompanhamento detalhado do pipeline, assegurando a conversão em cada etapa.
  • Acompanhamento contínuo: Manter contatos regulares e estruturados com potenciais clientes para estreitar relacionamentos.
  • Gestão de relacionamento: Ser referência no atendimento às demandas dos parceiros, garantindo uma experiência incrível desde o início.
  • Colaboração estratégica: Trabalhar de forma integrada com o time para maximizar resultados e impulsionar a presença do iFood na cidade de Açu - RN.

Ingredientes que Buscamos

  • Experiência em vendas: Um diferencial será ter atuado com vendas externas, prospecção ou gestão de carteira.
  • Comunicação excepcional: Habilidade oral e escrita para interações via telefone, WhatsApp e e-mail.
  • Perfil organizado e resiliente: Energia, senso de dono e capacidade de se adaptar a um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Habilidade de negociação e persuasão: Capacidade de argumentar e buscar resultados acima da média, sempre com foco no cliente.
  • Relacionamento interpessoal: Facilidade em criar conexões significativas e construir parcerias de longo prazo.
  • Morar na cidade e ter como se locomover: Ser residente da cidade de Açu - RN e possuir mobilidade para realizar deslocamentos com facilidade.

Sobre Nós

No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e alcançar #Resultados incríveis. Por isso, valorizamos candidatos independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Temos grupos compostos por foodlovers voluntários, onde falamos sobre Raça, Gênero, LGBTQI+ e PcD. Queremos ser a empresa onde as pessoas escolham se desenvolver e realizar seus sonhos. #AllTogether.

Conheça nossas iniciativas | Institucional iFood

Você Tem Fome de Quê?

Temos fome de inovação e resultados. Sempre buscamos fazer o nosso melhor, pensando "fora da caixa" e agindo com agilidade e responsabilidade. Valorizamos a diversidade, o conhecimento e o compartilhamento em um ambiente dinâmico e versátil. O ingrediente especial da nossa receita? As pessoas. Vem fazer parte disso!

title: UX & Top Value Users Specialist
description:
About the Position

We are looking for a strategic and user-centric professional to lead our UX & Top Value Users initiatives. This role focuses on designing and delivering differentiated experiences for our highest-value customers, ensuring they receive premium treatment, flawless service levels, and long-term loyalty benefits. You will work cross-functionally with Operations, Compensations, and Restaurant teams to align service delivery, while also identifying and addressing UX improvements that elevate the overall user journey for all segments.

Responsibilities

  • Define criteria for identifying Top Value Users (e.g., GMV, frequency, LTV) and continuously refine segmentation.
  • Design and implement differentiated service levels for top cohorts (priority support, faster delivery times, premium compensations).
  • Partner with Operations and Restaurant teams to guarantee SLA adherence and premium experience delivery.
  • Develop and launch “surprise & delight” initiatives and exclusive benefits to retain and grow loyalty among top users.
  • Conduct UX research and analysis to identify friction points and propose solutions that improve the overall experience.
  • Collaborate with Product and Design teams to prioritize UX enhancements and premium journey flows.
  • Build dashboards and reporting systems to monitor satisfaction, retention, and GMV contribution of top user cohorts.
  • Serve as the internal advocate for top-value users, ensuring their needs are represented in cross-team strategies.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in business, design, engineering, or related fields.
  • Robust experience in user operations, CX, CRM, or growth, preferably with exposure to premium or segmented service strategies.
  • Strong knowledge of UX principles, customer journey design, and service-level differentiation.
  • Analytical skills with proficiency in SQL, Python, or other tools to analyze user data and monitor KPIs.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across multiple teams (Ops, Product, Design, Growth, Restaurants).
  • Experience in e-commerce, O2O, food delivery, or customer experience roles preferred.
  • Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
  • User-first mindset with creativity and execution excellence to balance business value with user delight.

title: Principal Architect
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.

  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.

  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.

  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.

  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership:

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.

  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and expand the scope of sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and areas where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.

  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development:

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.

  • Provide summarized and business-relevant feedback to content, Product Management, Product Marketing, Competitive Marketing, and Field Marketing to improve the effectiveness of the value proposition.

  • Maintain continuous self-improvement and learning to sustain technical leadership across relevant technologies (e.g., security technologies, cyber threat intelligence, risk and regulatory topics, emerging technologies)

  • Work closely with Sales and Solution Consulting leadership, Unit42 consulting teams, Business Value Consultants, Professional Services, Customer Success, and theater CISO/CTO resources (where applicable) to ensure a coordinated market approach.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience as an end customer, a cybersecurity vendor or consultant is required.

  • Education: BSCS, equivalent degree or experience is required.

  • Architectural Knowledge:

    • Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.

    • Solid fundamental background in principles and practices of networking and/or cloud computing.

    • Knowledge of security areas such as network security, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud security, identity management, security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI.

  • Executive Presence: Demonstrable experience in establishing credibility and strategic messaging with large enterprise executives (CISO and above).

  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally.

  • Drive and Problem Solving:

    • A "Whatever it takes" attitude and motivation to overcome obstacles necessary to achieve desired outcomes and close deals.

    • Robust problem finding and solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems with systematic approaches to quick resolution, even under duress.

  • Travel: Expect to travel a minimum of 50%+ of the weeks in the fiscal year. Travel will include customer and company location onsite meetings.

  • Organizational Skills: Superb organizational skills are required.

Additional Information

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

description:
About Keeta

title: Tax Sr Analyst (Advanced English)
description:
Join Our Team as Tax Sr Analyst – Brazil (São Paulo) Advanced English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Department: Finance LATAM

Reports to: Senior Tax Manager LATAM

Are you a seasoned tax professional ready to lead and make an impact in a global organization? We’re looking for a Tax Sr Analyst to oversee tax compliance and strategic initiatives for our Brazilian entity. This is a fantastic opportunity to work in a dynamic, collaborative environment where your expertise will shape tax operations and support business growth.

What You’ll Do

As Tax Sr Analyst, you’ll be responsible for:

  • Leading tax compliance for direct and indirect taxes in Brazil.
  • Preparing tax calculations for review by external advisors (EY, Deloitte).
  • Managing deferred tax accounting (IFRS and BRGAAP), including annual and half-year calculations.
  • Overseeing reconciliations for tax GL accounts using SAP and Blackline.
  • Coordinating SPED, municipal obligations (withholding tax), IBGE, and BACEN reporting.
  • Supporting Transfer Pricing processes with external specialists.
  • Advising internal teams on tax treatment for various operations.
  • Staying ahead of regulatory changes, including Brazil’s ongoing Tax Reform.
  • Collaborating with external auditors and tax authorities during audits.
  • Leading a team of 3 direct reports and coordinating with cross-functional teams.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: Minimum 6 years in Brazilian tax (local & international), tax accounting, and compliance.
  • Education: Degree in Accounting or Tax.
  • Technical Skills: SAP, SPED, HFM (BRACS), Blackline.
  • Tax Expertise: IRPJ, CSLL, ISS, PIS, COFINS, ICMS; knowledge of tax treaties and audit processes.
  • Languages: Advanced English required; Spanish is a plus.
  • Soft Skills: Strong communication, analytical mindset, team leadership, and collaboration.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a global company with a strong presence in LATAM.
  • Lead impactful tax projects and contribute to strategic decisions.
  • Work in a collaborative and inclusive environment.
  • Grow your career with opportunities for development and innovation.

title: Formação em Corretor de Seguros
description:
Quer redirecionar sua carreira profissional, aprender uma nova profissão e iniciar seu próprio negócio? Venha atuar como Corretor de Vida e Previdência na MAG Seguros!

Você ingressará no nosso Programa para Formação de Novos Corretores, onde aprenderá tudo sobre Seguro de Vida e Previdência. Realizará o curso preparatório para o exame de Habilitação Técnico Profissional e, ao ser aprovado, terá sua licença para atuar como Corretor de Seguros, começando o seu próprio negócio, com todo o suporte e expertise da MAG Seguros.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:

  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep;

Após a conquista da Habilitação:

  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações;
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas;
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil;
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Aptidão para vendas;
  • Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento);
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;

Você se diferenciará, se possuir:

  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.
